scope: Late CI live-credential scheduling and loop-gate preparation/isolation fixes

reproductions_before_fix.finding: live-harness job had no event/ref guard and could schedule ordinary PR code on a credentialed configured runner

reproductions_before_fix.command:
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --mount type=bind,src=/Users/raptor/aef-core,dst=/repo,readonly --workdir /repo --env PIP_RETRIES=0 --env PIP_TIMEOUT=3 python:3.13-slim sh -e -c 'python -m pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -e ".[dev]"'
reproductions_before_fix.finding: fresh build dependency hatchling cannot be installed inside the old job-level network-none container

implementation: Credentialed live job requires push to refs/heads/main; ordinary hosted PR test job remains enabled.
Gate remains manual workflow_dispatch with read-only contents permission and now requires dispatch from main.
Trusted main archive builds a runtime image with git and dependencies before fetching candidate data.
Dispatch head is a validated branch-name environment value, never interpolated into shell source.
Fresh Git repository receives main/candidate objects and refs without source auth config or hooks; only main is checked out on host.
Gate uses real Docker --network none, --pull never, read-only root and source, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, unprivileged UID, tmpfs scratch, writable external state, and no host fallback.
Report uses the same trusted installed image with network disabled and read-only source/state.
Core workflow is byte-identical to its shared renderer; core explicitly selects the same demo graph as monitor.

checks_observed: Exact rendered Build/Fetch/Gate/Report scripts executed from disposable fixture, including source paths containing spaces.
Trusted image built successfully; git and installed AEF available.
G0/G1/G4 passed; G5 rejected absent baseline as expected; report verified three-entry ledger chain.
Candidate execution was nonroot; /repo and /opt/aef-base were read-only.
Candidate workspace, /tmp, /work and state were writable.
Fixture host credential environment and Docker socket were absent; fresh Git config/hooks excluded fixture auth/hook.

limitations: No hosted GitHub Actions dispatch or authenticated/live model call was run; no hosted live-harness outcome is claimed.

A condition inside editable pull_request YAML alone cannot secure a credentialed self-hosted runner against malicious workflow edits. Owner must separately restrict allowed repositories/workflows/runner groups or use an isolated credential arrangement.

Adopter template still requires owner selection of main/default branch, real agent entrypoint, green-bar build command and any custom/private dependency setup. Existing owner workflow files remain preserved by adoption.
Real Docker smoke used a disposable fixture and deliberately stopped at G5 missing-baseline rejection; it does not establish a complete six-gate corpus result or learning improvement.
Shell recorder tests verify command construction and fail-closed status propagation; actual isolation evidence comes separately from the independent Docker smoke.
Full suite and repository-wide release validation are owned by parent; this subtask ran focused checks only.
